findings.issue: getHomeData builds a home-page-specific view model (types per species, generation lookup) inside the data-access module
findings.suggestion: Move page view models into pages/home.ts or a view/ layer, keeping api.ts to transport, types and shared lookups

findings.issue: Four hand-rolled copies of the memoized-promise-with-error-reset pattern
findings.suggestion: Add a single memoize(fn) helper so caching/invalidation rules change in one place

findings.issue: Every card-listing page must know about and fetch the species index itself and thread it through helpers
findings.suggestion: Wrap it: speciesFromPokemonListAsync(list) that awaits getSpeciesIndex internally

findings.issue: loadMoveTables uses apiFetch<any> and a record: any map even though MoveRecord is defined in api.ts
findings.suggestion: Type the fetch as apiFetch<MoveRecord> so API shape changes are caught

findings.issue: Hash-scroll-into-view logic duplicated in the router and the Pokémon page
findings.suggestion: Keep it only in the router; drop the copy in the page

findings.issue: Move-table columns declared twice (level-up vs rest) and rendered with per-column switch logic in sortRows
findings.suggestion: Describe columns once as data (key, label, sortable, included-for) and derive headers, cells and sort keys from it

findings.issue: Inline onerror handler embedded in the card template string
findings.suggestion: Attach the fallback via a delegated listener in main.ts, keeping behaviour out of markup

findings.issue: details.ts is a grab-bag of moves, abilities, types and not-found; each new resource type grows it
findings.suggestion: Split per resource (moves.ts, abilities.ts, types.ts) so pages mirror routes

findings.issue: detailRow's HTML is shared, but the surrounding page scaffold (<div class="page">, panels, headings) is copy-pasted per page
findings.suggestion: Extract a pageShell/panel helper to make new detail pages reuse the scaffold

summary: A tidy, small vanilla-TS app whose real seams — shared card renderer, fetch cache, href/badge helpers — are in the right places, so bug fixes mostly land in one spot. The main editability costs are duplicated patterns (four memo singletons, page scaffolds, hash-scroll) and a data module that knows page-specific view models. Removing or adding a whole resource type is a handful of well-greppable edits across six-ish files, which is acceptable but not exemplary.
